{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Keep only the latest (highest sample_seq) row per patient
df = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Create a copy for analysis
analysis_df = df.copy()

# Replace sentinel -999.0 with NaN for biomarker_baseline
analysis_df['biomarker_baseline'] = analysis_df['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Check how many rows have missing biomarker_baseline after replacement
print("Rows with missing biomarker_baseline after sentinel replacement:", analysis_df['biomarker_baseline'].isnull().sum())

# Check response rate by sex and arm
response_by_sex_arm = analysis_df.groupby(['sex', 'arm'])['responded'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)
print("\nResponse rate by sex and arm:")
print(response_by_sex_arm)

# Check severity distribution by sex and arm
severity_by_sex_arm = pd.crosstab(analysis_df['sex'], [analysis_df['arm'], analysis_df['severity']])
print("\nSeverity distribution by sex and arm:")
print(severity_by_sex_arm)"}
